_comment: Command-line tools scripts/plugin_index.py probes with shutil.which. Each purpose is taken from the tool's own --help / usage text (read 2026-11-09). `probe` is a harmless command for a human or agent to confirm the tool; plugin_index.py never runs it.

tools.name: rosslabs-lsp
tools.purpose: Compiler-grade code intelligence for any agent: def, refs and hover by symbol name, file diagnostics, and routing to the right tool for a topic.

tools.name: architect
tools.purpose: Verified architecture graph: scan a repo, validate, query and track it, and render data or dependency diagrams.

tools.name: et
tools.purpose: CLI front-door for Easy Terminal: panes, agents, workspaces, the merge queue, and `et view open` to show an HTML file or local server in the Canvas.

tools.name: ibr
tools.purpose: End-to-end design tool for AI coding agents: scan, capture and compare rendered web or native UI.

tools.name: rally
tools.purpose: Repo-local coordination room for parallel agents: enter, claim paths, post handoffs and read the inbox.

tools.name: navgator
tools.purpose: Architecture connection tracker - know your stack before you change it: scan, impact, connections, trace.

tools.name: codex
tools.purpose: Codex CLI: interactive by default; `codex exec` runs non-interactively and `codex review` runs a code review.

tools.name: claude
tools.purpose: Claude Code: starts an interactive session by default; -p/--print gives non-interactive output.
